text: The doctor reads a new patient's old records before the visit. Ask for them early.
Biscuit is new to us. Tom says his old vet was Maplewood Animal Hospital.
The one thing to remember: request records as soon as the visit is booked, and tick authorization only when the family has said yes.
If they're not in the directory, type the name and their records email.
Tick this only when the family has said yes. It's saved with your name and today's date.
Done. It's listed under Already asked.
The RR badge shows records are on their way: yellow while waiting, green when everything is in.
Families who list their old vet on the online form don't need this. Scout sends those requests by itself.

The most common mistakes: waiting until the day before the visit to ask, and ticking authorization without asking the family. Remember: request records from the visit as soon as it's booked, and tick the authorization box only when the family has said yes.
